Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.infrastructure.github

Class GitHubVerifiedEmailLookup

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.infrastructure.github.GitHubVerifiedEmailLookup
All Implemented Interfaces:
VerifiedEmailLookup
@Component public class GitHubVerifiedEmailLookup extends Object implements VerifiedEmailLookup
VerifiedEmailLookup over GitHub's GET /user/emails, called through the client generated from apis/github/rest-server/github-api-v1.yaml. The email of GitHub's profile is whatever the user chose to show and is not verified, so the address is read from that endpoint, which flags each address as primary and verified.

The base URI of the API is the user-info URI of the registration without its trailing /user (by default https://api.github.com), so a GitHub Enterprise registration, or the fake provider of the tests, is called where it is. Every failure (GitHub unreachable, an error status, an unreadable body, a user-info URI of another shape) means "no verified address", which refuses the sign-in; it is logged without the token or anything of the user.
